title: The Lantern Street Chronicle
learning_focus: Sequential narrative, main idea, summary, feelings and traits, prediction, vocabulary, and culturally appropriate visuals.
story_premise: A family association is preparing a Chinese New Year street chronicle. A gust scatters seven illustrated events, leaving the youngest storyteller unsure how the family’s account begins and ends.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Sequential narrative, main idea, summary, feelings and traits, prediction, vocabulary, and culturally appropriate visuals.
